# merge

This is a merge of pre-trained language models created using [mergekit](https://github.com/cg123/mergekit).

## Merge Details
### Merge Method

This model was merged using the SLERP merge method.

### Models Merged

The following models were included in the merge:
* [suayptalha/HomerCreativeAnvita-Mix-Qw7B](https://huggingface.co/suayptalha/HomerCreativeAnvita-Mix-Qw7B)
* [jeffmeloy/Qwen2.5-7B-nerd-uncensored-v1.5](https://huggingface.co/jeffmeloy/Qwen2.5-7B-nerd-uncensored-v1.5)

### Configuration

The following YAML configuration was used to produce this model:

```yaml
slices:
- sources:
  - model: suayptalha/HomerCreativeAnvita-Mix-Qw7B
    layer_range:
    - 0
    - 28
  - model: jeffmeloy/Qwen2.5-7B-nerd-uncensored-v1.5
    layer_range:
    - 0
    - 28
merge_method: slerp
base_model: suayptalha/HomerCreativeAnvita-Mix-Qw7B
parameters:
  t:
  - filter: self_attn
    value:
    - 0
    - 0.5
    - 0.3
    - 0.7
    - 1
  - filter: mlp
    value:
    - 1
    - 0.5
    - 0.7
    - 0.3
    - 0
  - value: 0.5
dtype: bfloat16
